description: PAID (~$0.02). Resolved-outcome ATTESTATION for one Polymarket market: the SETTLED truth straight off the market row — resolved (bool), resolution (yes|no|null), resolved_at, and outcome_verified:{resolution:true}. Pure outcome-verified data — no modeled estimate anywhere. Optional side (yes|no): adds queried_side and correct (true iff side matches the resolved outcome) — use it to VERIFY whether a past signal, call, or advertised win-rate was actually right. Unknown/unresolvable market returns null and is NOT charged. Params: condition_id, side.
name: predge_attest
title: Outcome attestation — verified settled truth (flagship)
